paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea. The LORD doesn't hand Joshua a pep talk and a pat on the back. He hands him a promise: "As I was with Moses, so will I be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you." (Joshua 1:5) Joshua's courage doesn't come from Joshua. It comes from WHO is with him.

So when the LORD says, "Be strong and courageous," He gives Joshua something to hold while he does it. Joshua is to keep the Book of the Law on his lips, meditate on it day and night, and be careful to do everything written in it (Joshua 1:8). That's not a side job, friend. That's how he stays steady when the ground is shaking. I'd say it's like keeping your oven set right, because a good bake starts with the heat.

And look at how the people answer. They say, "Everything you have commanded us we will do," and they wish Joshua the same LORD who was with Moses (Joshua 1:16-17). Here's what I want you to take with you, baker: whatever is ahead of you, the LORD says, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." (Joshua 1:9) Hold that close, because this story isn't over.
